title: Monza Half Marathon (training race)
terrain: Autodromo di Monza, flat road circuit, 21.1km
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: km 0-5 at 4:45 (HR under 168), km 5-18 at 4:38-4:40 (cap 172), km 18+ open up. Target 1:37-1:40.
GYM: none.
FUEL: 1 Carbo Gel 10min before start, 1 at km 10-11, water at every station.
STOP RULE: HR over 175 before km 15, back off to 4:50 and run it as a tempo.
WHY: race counts as the week's long + threshold session; 20min cooldown jog makes it ~2h30 on feet.
